from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def mode(vals):
        return Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_modes = [mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    bg = mode(row_modes)
    # Separator lines are the regularly repeated rows/columns whose modal
    # color differs from the dominant cell/background color.
    rs = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v != bg]
    cs = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v != bg]
    if len(rs) < 2 or len(cs) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    line_color = mode([row_modes[r] for r in rs] + [col_modes[c] for c in cs])
    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(cs)-1)] for __ in range(len(rs)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            vals = [grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]],
                    grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            if vals[0] == vals[1] == vals[2] == vals[3] and vals[0] not in (bg, line_color):
                out[i][j] = vals[0]
    occupied = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    if occupied:
        r0=min(i for i,j in occupied); r1=max(i for i,j in occupied)
        c0=min(j for i,j in occupied); c1=max(j for i,j in occupied)
        out=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
    return out
PY
